subject: mom's birthday
body: mom's birthday is sunday. she needs a new jacket. can you chip in 40 for one? my coinbin is 0xb8d6e201b59c95094b2e417784b38b06c0c7e46a, send it by saturday so i can order. or grab one yourself and i'll cover my half.

outcomes.when: the player says they'll send the money or chip in, but hasn't sent it yet
outcomes.reply: i'll believe it when i see it.

outcomes.when: the player will buy the jacket themselves
outcomes.reply: legend. i'll send you my half on her birthday.

outcomes.when: the player makes an excuse or says they can't help
outcomes.reply: ok. i'll tell her you were busy.

hints: so is that a yes? 40 to 0xb8d6e201b59c95094b2e417784b38b06c0c7e46a by saturday. or buy it yourself and i'll send half. or just say you're out
